biggest_catch: The referred friend must present the ORIGINAL Refer-A-Friend form when applying - a referral passed along by word of mouth alone does not qualify, and the friend must meet a qualification within 90 days.
catches: Referring and referred members must be 18 years of age or older.
Referred member must present the original Refer-A-Friend form when applying for membership to qualify.

Mokelumne FCU will deposit $25 into both the referring member's and referred member's accounts once the referred member meets one of: 10+ debit-card transactions (PIN-based excluded), a monthly direct deposit of $300+, or financing a vehicle with Mokelumne FCU - qualification must be met within the first 90 days of account opening.
Referring member must be in good standing; Mokelumne FCU employees, officials, directors, and their immediate families are not eligible.
Referral payments may be taxable; offer cannot be combined with any other offer; Mokelumne FCU may change or cancel the offer at any time.
